normalize_100_derivative: Per market de-vig to 100%; P(odd)_CS = Σ_{h+a odd} p(h,a). Derivative insight: gap = P(odd)_CS - P(odd)_OE is the 'secret' slack; bet side where internal CS PMF disagrees with OE after normalization.
verdict: CS and OE are highly aligned — little arb; secret is in tails (Other score).
On disagreement, CS does not beat OE reliably — book is internally consistent.
Exact Score market IS the mathematical inverse of odd/even; O/E is marginal of CS PMF.
